@@U00863@@
Here's a green arbor!
Look, what a vine!
(He seizes 西贝尔 by the nose and the others with their raised
knives do the same.)

@@U00865@@
(With a solemn gesture.)

@@U00866@@
Error, remove the blindfold from their sight!
And you, remember how the Devil jests.

@@U00867@@
(He disappears with 浮士德. The others leap apart.)

@@U00869@@
What was that?

@@U00871@@
What!

@@U00873@@
Was that your nose?

@@U00875@@
(To 西贝尔.)

@@U00876@@
And look, here I’m holding yours!

@@U00878@@
There was a shock! It went right through me!
Quick! A chair! ?’'m about to faint!

@@U00880@@
No, what happened, tell me!

@@U00882@@
Where is he? Where’s he gone? That bastard!
He wont get away from me alive!

@@U00884@@
I saw him leave by the cellar door.
On a keg! He was riding it!
Ah! My feet! My feet are heavy as lead!
translation:
@@U00863@@
这里有一个绿色的凉亭！
看，多好的藤蔓呀！
（他抓住西贝尔的鼻子，其他人则用举起的
刀也有同样的作用。）

@@U00865@@
（以庄严的姿态。）

@@U00866@@
错误，把眼罩从他们的视线中拿开！
而你，请记住魔鬼是如何开玩笑的。

@@U00867@@
（他和浮士德一起消失。其他人跳开。）

@@U00869@@
那是什么？

@@U00871@@
什么！

@@U00873@@
那是你的鼻子吗？

@@U00875@@
（对西贝尔。）

@@U00876@@
看，我拿着你的！

@@U00878@@
震惊了！它直接穿过了我！
快的！一把椅子！ ？快要晕倒了！

@@U00880@@
不，发生了什么事，快告诉我！

@@U00882@@
他在哪儿？他去哪儿了？那个混蛋！
他不会活着离开我的！

@@U00884@@
我看见他从地窖门口离开。
在小桶上！他正在骑它！
啊!我的脚！我的脚像灌了铅一样沉重！
